observed_behavior: Delivery required knowledge gates accept Requirements and Planning Ready receipts that omit formal_paths and persist bindings that also omit the manifest.
expected_behavior: Every Ready receipt binds canonical Git-eligible formal_paths; Requirements names exactly the current revision and Planning exactly matches the owner-validated complete Ready-plan bundle.
impact: An incomplete or incorrect formal artifact manifest can bypass the phase gate and allow implementation without a reproducible complete approved plan bundle.

reproduction.symptom_oracle: A receipt without formal_paths must be rejected by Delivery with INVALID_KNOWLEDGE_PROMOTION while a complete owner-valid manifest remains accepted and is persisted exactly.
steps: Run the existing required-stage-gates fixture while observing the receipt and returned promotion binding.
Confirm both Requirements and Planning receipts lack formal_paths but are accepted.
Pass the same receipts to project-knowledge validate_stage_promotion and observe MISSING_KNOWLEDGE_GATE.
reproduction.sample: One of one isolated Delivery fixture accepted two of two invalid receipts; the authoritative project-knowledge consumer rejected both.

root_cause.summary: Delivery duplicates Ready receipt validation but omits formal_paths and does not call the authoritative project-knowledge stage validator; its positive fixture also omits the field, canonizing the bypass.

next_action: Implementation executor stays in Fixing, adds missing, malformed and incomplete formal_paths regression reds, enforces owner-equivalent validation and persists exact formal_paths before rerunning producer, consumer, Delivery and fresh review.
